title: helm(private): tolerations for init-hooks + upgrade/rollback stability
author: Jordan Patel
description: Motivation: clusters with tainted nodes (e.g. dedicated infra nodes or GPU pools) could prevent Helm init-hook jobs from scheduling during install/upgrade, which in turn caused upgrades to stall or time out. This PR adds first-class tolerations and nodeSelector support for the private Helm chart init hooks and stabilizes upgrade/rollback semantics when new values are present. The change is backward-compatible: default behavior is unchanged unless explicit tolerations/nodeSelector are provided in values. Changes in this PR: 1) values.schema.json: introduce .initJobs.tolerations (list), .initJobs.nodeSelector (map), and .initJobs.podAnnotations (map) with schema examples and descriptions; 2) templates/init-job.yaml: propagate tolerations/nodeSelector/podAnnotations into the init job Pod spec and apply the correct hook annotations (helm.sh/hook: pre-install, pre-upgrade) with weight and delete policies; 3) templates/_helpers.tpl: add helper function to render tolerations in a compact, stable way to reduce diff noise across upgrades; 4) Chart.yaml/README: document new values and migration notes; 5) scripts/ensure-tolerations.sh: small helper used by e2e to validate scheduling in tainted clusters; 6) terraform/module README: note that customers using tainted nodes should pass initJobs.* into helm_release inputs. Migration notes and rollback behavior: when upgrading from older chart versions the hook job will prefer tolerations/nodeSelector if present in values, but if the cluster cannot schedule the job the hook implements a 10m backoff with exponential retry and emits a clear event and Helm failure message to help operators decide on manual intervention. The hook also annotates the release with the applied init job version so rollback path can identify whether toleration fields need to be removed to return to previous behavior. Testing and verification: unit schema validation, helm lint, and full e2e on a tainted-node testbed were run. A targeted upgrade/rollback test was added to the perf-canary harness to ensure no stuck upgrades. Security and compat: no secrets added or changed. Release notes: Add tolerations/nodeSelector/podAnnotations for private init-hooks to support tainted node topologies; backward compatible; operator action: specify values.initJobs.tolerations when deploying to clusters with tainted nodes. Checklist: - [x] values.schema updated with examples - [x] init hook templates updated and tested locally - [x] helm lint and unit tests pass - [x] e2e/upgrade-rollback test added and green - [x] documented in Chart README - [x] added terraform note for module consumers Related PRs: pr-54123-helm-private-values-init-hooks-kms-nodeselector.json (reference for nodeSelector work), pr-53250-helm-private-values-init-hooks-kms-tolerations.json (prior tolerations experiment).
